bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm water (>25 degC), high phosphorus (TP >50 ug/L), calm stratified conditions, high light
notes: Produces microcystins (hepatotoxins); most globally reported HAB species; surface scums in still water

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm temperatures (20-30 degC), low N:P ratio, calm winds, moderate to high phosphorus
notes: Produces anatoxins and microcystins; nitrogen-fixing; common in eutrophic lakes and reservoirs

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm water (18-28 degC), low nitrogen, high phosphorus, stable stratification
notes: Nitrogen-fixer; produces saxitoxins in some strains; forms floating bundle-shaped colonies

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm to subtropical temperatures (>25 degC), low N:P ratio, extended thermal stratification
notes: Produces cylindrospermopsin; expanding range poleward due to climate warming; tolerates low light

bloom_trigger_conditions: Brackish to marine, warm summer temperatures, high phosphorus, low nitrogen
notes: Produces nodularin (hepatotoxin); characteristic of Baltic Sea and Australian estuaries

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm slow-flowing rivers (>20 degC), elevated nutrients, calm conditions
notes: Produces saxitoxins and geosmin; problematic in Australian rivers

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool to warm temperatures (10-25 degC), high phosphorus, deep mixing, low light tolerance
notes: Produces microcystins; thrives in turbid well-mixed polymictic lakes; can bloom year-round

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm tropical to subtropical marine/freshwater (>22 degC), high phosphorus, low grazing pressure
notes: Produces lyngbyatoxin-a; benthic mat-former; causes swimmers itch and fish kills

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm coastal ocean (>24 degC), low-salinity surface layer, upwelling of nutrient-rich deep water
notes: Produces brevetoxins; marine fish kills; aerosol causes respiratory irritation

bloom_trigger_conditions: Coastal marine/estuarine, warm stratified waters (16-24 degC), elevated nutrients from runoff
notes: Produces saxitoxins; major shellfish industry threat

bloom_trigger_conditions: Marine, warm waters (>20 degC), high organic matter, calm seas
notes: Non-toxic but produces ammonia causing fish kills; responsible for bioluminescent tides

bloom_trigger_conditions: Brackish water (1-20 ppt salinity), warm temperatures, elevated nutrients
notes: Produces prymnesins; causes widespread fish and invertebrate kills

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool to temperate coastal upwelling zones (12-20 degC), high silica and nitrate
notes: Produces domoic acid (amnesic shellfish poisoning); linked to marine mammal mortality

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool to warm freshwater (10-25 degC), high turbulence/mixing, elevated silica and nitrate
notes: Non-toxic sentinel species; indicates eutrophication and spring turnover

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cold to cool water (5-15 degC), high phosphorus and silica, winter-spring mixing events
notes: Non-toxic; indicator of hypereutrophic conditions; dense blooms can clog water treatment filters

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool temperate lakes (10-20 degC), moderate nutrients, seasonal mixing
notes: Non-toxic sentinel; nuisance filter-clogging in water supply reservoirs

bloom_trigger_conditions: Wide temperature range (15-35 degC), high nitrogen and phosphorus, high light
notes: Non-toxic; rapid-growth indicator species in eutrophic ponds

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm water (15-28 degC), high phosphorus and light, shallow hard-substrate streams
notes: Non-toxic; forms dense mats that deoxygenate water on decomposition

bloom_trigger_conditions: Coastal marine and estuarine, elevated nitrogen and phosphorus, warm calm waters
notes: Non-toxic macroalgae; green tide indicator in nitrogen-enriched coastal zones

bloom_trigger_conditions: Slow-flowing or still freshwater, spring warmth (10-20 degC), moderate to high nutrients
notes: Non-toxic; spiral chloroplast morphology; early-season indicator of nutrient enrichment

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm eutrophic lakes (>22 degC), elevated phosphorus, calm conditions
notes: Produces microcystins at lower concentrations than M. aeruginosa; colony mucilage provides buoyancy

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm stratified lakes, moderate phosphorus, summer conditions
notes: Spherical colonies; low toxin production; indicator of early eutrophication

bloom_trigger_conditions: Subtropical and tropical lakes (>23 degC), low N:P ratio
notes: Related to Cylindrospermopsis; produces cylindrospermopsin in some populations

bloom_trigger_conditions: Slow-flowing streams and ponds, high organic matter, moderate temperatures
notes: Benthic mat-former; produces low-level geosmin causing taste and odour issues

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool fast-flowing streams, rocky substrates, nutrient-enriched conditions
notes: Benthic mat-former in streams; produces anatoxin-a; linked to dog deaths in NZ and Australia

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm oligotrophic tropical marine waters (>25 degC), nitrogen-fixing conditions
notes: Major marine nitrogen fixer; forms surface aggregates visible from satellites; open-ocean blooms

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm stratified eutrophic lakes and reservoirs (>18 degC), high phosphorus
notes: Non-toxic; large cells; nuisance clogging of water supply filters; taste and odour producer

bloom_trigger_conditions: Thermally stratified lakes, moderate nutrients, warm summer conditions
notes: Non-toxic; common in temperate eutrophic lakes; contributes to coloured water

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool coastal upwelling zones (12-16 degC), post-upwelling relaxation, elevated nutrients
notes: Produces saxitoxins; major paralytic shellfish poisoning risk in Australia and New Zealand

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool coastal marine (8-16 degC), stratified conditions, Mesodinium prey present
notes: Produces okadaic acid and dinophysistoxins (diarrhoea shellfish poisoning); globally distributed

bloom_trigger_conditions: Coastal marine and estuarine, warm summer temperatures (15-25 degC), stratified conditions
notes: Produces reactive oxygen species and ichthyotoxins; causes recurrent salmon aquaculture losses

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm shallow coastal bays (>20 degC), high nutrients, stratified conditions
notes: Produces haemolytic and ichthyotoxic compounds; major fish kill agent in Japanese coastal waters

bloom_trigger_conditions: Shallow coastal lagoons and bays, elevated dissolved organic nitrogen, warm calm summer
notes: Non-toxic but outcompetes shellfish food sources; causes economic losses in shellfish aquaculture

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm eutrophic lakes (20-28 degC), high nutrients, stable low-wind conditions
notes: Non-toxic; warm-season diatom; replacement species as lakes shift from Aulacoseira dominance

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool oligotrophic to mesotrophic lakes, low phosphorus, seasonal mixing
notes: Non-toxic; sensitive to eutrophication; used as paleolimnological indicator of past water quality

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool spring conditions (5-15 degC), high silica, moderately high phosphorus
notes: Non-toxic; characteristic spring bloom species in temperate lakes; star-shaped colonies

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm eutrophic ponds and lakes (15-30 degC), high nutrients
notes: Non-toxic; indicator of enriched conditions; very slender needle-shaped cells

bloom_trigger_conditions: Shallow nutrient-rich ponds and wetlands, warm temperatures, high organic matter
notes: Produces euglenophycin; red surface blooms; indicator of high organic loading

bloom_trigger_conditions: Eutrophic ponds and slow streams, high nutrients, warm conditions
notes: Non-toxic; iron-encrusted lorica; indicator of organic enrichment; tolerates low oxygen

bloom_trigger_conditions: Eutrophic ponds and lakes, high nutrients, wide temperature range
notes: Non-toxic; coenobial green alga; used in wastewater treatment; fast-growing biomass producer

bloom_trigger_conditions: Eutrophic to mesotrophic lakes, warm summer conditions, moderate to high phosphorus
notes: Non-toxic; flat disc-shaped coenobium; preserved well in sediments for paleolimnology

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm eutrophic ponds (>20 degC), high phosphorus, calm conditions
notes: Non-toxic; large spherical coenobium visible to naked eye; indicator of nutrient enrichment

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm oligotrophic to mesotrophic lakes (15-30 degC), low nitrogen relative to phosphorus
notes: Non-toxic; produces hydrocarbons; potential biofuel feedstock; forms surface oily films

bloom_trigger_conditions: Hypersaline environments (>70 ppt), warm sunny conditions, low nutrients
notes: Non-toxic; produces beta-carotene and glycerol; used in commercial nutraceutical production

bloom_trigger_conditions: Coastal marine and estuarine, cool to moderate temperatures, high nutrients from upwelling
notes: Non-toxic; important marine primary producer; aquaculture feed species; spring bloom contributor

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool coastal marine (5-15 degC), high silica and nitrate, spring mixing events
notes: Non-toxic; globally dominant spring bloom diatom; indicator of healthy coastal productivity

bloom_trigger_conditions: Cool to temperate coastal marine (5-15 degC), high nitrate after winter mixing
notes: Non-toxic individually; large colonies produce foam on beaches; reduces palatability for grazers

bloom_trigger_conditions: Open ocean and coastal marine, moderately warm (10-20 degC), post-bloom low-nutrient conditions
notes: Non-toxic; calcite plates give milky turquoise appearance from satellite; major carbon sink

bloom_trigger_conditions: Coastal marine, warm stratified summer conditions, moderate nutrients
notes: Produces yessotoxins at low concentrations; widespread coastal species; bioluminescent

bloom_trigger_conditions: Warm tropical marine (>22 degC), oligotrophic coral reef conditions
notes: Non-toxic; endosymbiotic in coral; coral bleaching follows expulsion under thermal stress
